title: A Wreck for the Rivergate
author: Hazel Dunmore
blurb: Hazel Thornbury, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
